response.overview: An unnamed man descends from his garden into a series of strange and increasingly disturbing spaces, where a pale figure known as the Beak appears without warning. As reality begins to unravel, he encounters creatures of evil, a motionless woman, something concealed within a sealed black box, and a disturbing presence beneath the surface.
response.tagline: THE FLESH OPENS THROUGH THE BEAK
response.title: Purple Roots
